item.description:
### Finish Patchy's setup from the app
Patchy 1.4.1 won't add a site until its one-time setup has run on your Mac. If Patchy UI finds setup hasn't finished when you add a site, it says so and offers **Finish Setup**. That runs the setup, asking for your Mac password if it needs it, and then adds your site.
Made for **Patchy 1.4.1**. Update Patchy first, in Terminal: `brew upgrade joeworkman/patchy/patchy`

### A tidier site page
- **One row of actions** beside the site's name: **Copy Address**, **Open in Browser**, **Share**, and a **…** menu with Reveal in Finder and Remove Site. - **Today at a glance.** Each site's page now counts today's errors and visits. Click either one to jump straight to that log. - **A more compact sidebar.** Each site takes one line, and a mark appears only beside sites that need attention. Certificate details live on the site's page.
### Server controls in one menu
Click **Running · PHP 8.5** in the toolbar to restart or stop the server. When more than one version of PHP is installed, you can also switch between them there.
### Every way to share
Patchy 1.4.0 adds new ways to share a site, and Share now offers all of them once you've connected your own domain:
- **Your site's own address** on your domain, open to anyone or **with a password**. - **Change Address…** picks the name before your domain, such as `preview.example.com`. Patchy remembers it for next time. - **A random address** on your domain that is new each time, open or with a password. - **A public link** on trycloudflare.com, even when a domain is connected.
To stop using your domain, go to **Settings › General** and choose **Disconnect**.
Made for **Patchy 1.4.0**. Update Patchy first, in Terminal: `brew upgrade joeworkman/patchy/patchy`

### A new menu bar panel
The menu bar menu is now a panel built for getting to your sites fast.
- **Search as you type.** Type part of a site's name and press Return to open it in your browser. The arrow keys move through the list. - **Open it from anywhere with a keyboard shortcut.** Set one in Settings › General, and you can find and open any site without touching the mouse. - **Sites that need attention come first,** then your groups, then everything else. - **Server controls at the top** (Start, Stop, Restart) and **quick buttons at the bottom** for adding a site, Settings and opening Patchy UI. - **Shared sites show in the panel too,** with Copy Link and Stop Sharing.
### Share a site at a public link
Show a client a preview without uploading anything. Click **Share** on any site and you get a link that works until you stop sharing.
- **Use your own domain.** Once you've connected one with `patchy share setup`, Share asks each time: your site's own address on that domain, **with a password** or **without one**, or a **temporary address** that is new each time. - **Passwords are made for you,** new each time you share. **Copy Address and Password** puts everything your client needs on the clipboard, ready to paste into a message. - **Links stop when you stop.** Sharing ends when you click Stop Sharing, stop the server or quit the app, and Patchy removes the address from your domain.
### Under the hood
- Patchy UI now asks Patchy for everything through its new machine-readable output instead of reading Patchy's files, so future Patchy releases are much less likely to break it. - Changing a site's folder now uses Patchy's own `patchy folder` command. - While a change runs, the app shows one step instead of a checklist, because Patchy now reports only the result.
Made for **Patchy 1.3.0**. Update Patchy first, in Terminal: `brew upgrade joeworkman/patchy/patchy`
